messages:
alana: dropped new frames for the first-run flow — checklist + sample project cards. need quick takes on rail vs modal, microcopy, and any a11y blockers before we lock.
sofia: scanning now. quick take: rail = lower friction, modal = higher completion. prefer rail but must be dismissible.
mike: +1 rail. design q: collapse to icon bar on mobile? keeps header real estate.
rahul: technically trivial to persist collapse in localStorage. enterprise/private should get server-backed restore though.
jess: agree — support tickets spike when progress disappears. suggest demo orgs use server restore.
sofia: microcopy note: make checklist verbs explicit. eg: \"Connect model or try sandbox\" vs \"Connect a model\". sets expectation.
aria: a11y notes:
- ensure rail toggle has aria-expanded and keyboard focus
- CTAs need 4.5:1 contrast for small text
- ephemeral token announcement must be accessible and marked aria-live if it's shown once
mike: sample cards: CTA -> \"Open sample app\" (short). add tiny footer meta: est tokens · est latency. badge: sandbox/dedicated.
jess: auth flow idea: spin up ephemeral org + single-use token shown once with copy: \"This token will not be shown again. Expires in 24h.\"
rahul: avoid storing raw key in DOM. render in ephemeral modal, revoke after copy or timeout. server should mark as single-show.
sofia: sample gallery: ship with 3 curated flows (chat assistant, semantic search, summarizer) and a \"Browse more\" modal for power users.
mike: visual: after completing checklist, show condensed "Completed" state with tiny confetti microinteraction and "Replay walkthrough" in settings.
alana: action items:
- mike: update Figma with collapsible rail + mobile icon variant (due Wed)
- sofia + aria: finalize microcopy & a11y checklist (due Tue)
- rahul + jess: design ephemeral org + token UX + server restore hook (due Thu)
- me: outline analytics events for first-run funnel (due Tue)
jess: analytics events proposed: onboard.started, sample.opened, token.copied, onboard.completed — will add to tracking doc.
aria: I'll run a VoiceOver pass once Figma is updated and flag keyboard traps.
rahul: I'll prototype client-side state + feature flag for server restore. PR when ready.
sofia: tiny A/B idea: CTA text test — "Open sample app" vs "Launch sample" for new users.
jess: can run A/B in hosted only.
alana: love it. avoid jargon in user copy (eg. use "speed tweaks" not "KV cache warmup").
ops-bot: Preview available at https://staging.redwood.ai/onboard/rail-preview (build 2026-03-23_09:42)
